newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Surgical Corp wins patent case.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Surgical Corp wins patent case.

text.p: U.S. Surgical Corp said Thursday, that a U.S. District Court judge, for the Southern District of Ohio, threw out, for a second time, a patent infringement suit brought against the company by Ethicon Endo Surgery, a division of Johnson & Johnson.

In a statement, U.S. Surgical said the suit relating to its open GIA linear cutters was dismissed because the judge found that the GIA linear cutters did not infringe any of Ethicon's asserted patent claims.
Open GIA linear cutters are surgical devices used for cutting and stapling in bowel and lung operations.
The original suit by Ethicon was filed in February of 1994.
